objective: Fix invisible/white typed message text on white Connect composer in Android dark mode; keep placeholder, reply, and light attachment icons legible and reject recurrence.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main 63ccd4b58ff02ff3c1535a1e05d3097fa8323c61 before isolated change; current EAS production manifest, installed runtime, and exact OTA provenance have not been re-read. DEV branch is NOT deployed. Screenshot 2026-11-16 shows near-invisible typed text in Cluster Connect.
chosenApproach: Keep existing white HIBLA Connect composer surface, use paired HIBLA ink/muted foreground, coordinated pale-attachment/action colors and input selection tint. Cover contrast and core sending contract with standalone dependency-free Node tests; no DB/native/ads/nav changes.
selectionRationale: The composer pill is hardcoded white while typed text/placeholder inherited dark-theme text roles (white), so dark-mode foreground clashes with its real background. Pairing fixed surface and foreground is minimal and preserves the existing HIBLA aesthetic across public, direct, organization and cluster threads.
alternativeApproaches: Pair fixed HIBLA white/light surfaces with corresponding high-contrast HIBLA foreground colors (selected).
Make all composer backgrounds dynamic theme surfaces; broader design/layout change not needed for this isolated defect.
Override global night-mode text colors; rejected because it would regress dark cards and chat bubbles.
preserveBehaviors: Personal/direct, Cluster/Organization scope threads share the same composer
Draft text, emoji, send and quick-reaction behavior unchanged
Android keyboard position/multiline and web Enter-send guards unchanged
No change to AdMob/dashboard rendering, Wall, PTT, database or native dependencies
No automatic staging/production publish without exact-source QA and release attestation
acceptanceChecks: No theme.textPrimary on fixed white TextInput
Ink on white at least 7:1; placeholder muted on white at least 4.5:1
Reply and icon color contrast on mint/pale green >=4.5:1
Focused Node regression tests and existing Connect keyboard tests pass
Android light/dark and direct/scope visual/device check when test device is available; user can waive actual device check, not CI/release gates
Keep isolated DEV change until cumulative staging RC/release workflow verifies exact source and AdMob/navigation protected gates

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Constrain the shared direct/scope Connect composer to readable foreground colors on its fixed light background without altering message/keyboard transport.
preservedBehaviors: Typed drafts remain editable and sent through the existing canonical message transport.
Native Android keyboard behavior, attachment buttons and reactions are preserved.
No media, AdMob, dashboard, notification, backend or runtime changes.
